purpose: Test the unresolved common-mode checker failure from recovery-block-style switching: a bad alternate must not gain authority or credit merely because one fallible acceptance checker says PASS.
mechanism_placeholder: two genuinely different acceptance views with disagreement quarantine
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local fixed trace only; no general theorem that two checks eliminate correlated failures.

checker_contract.Q2: independent relation/invariant checker over a paired or transformed observation
checker_contract.independence_guard: A duplicate, paraphrase, or mechanically copied Q1 verdict does not count as Q2.
checker_contract.promotion_rule: Authority/credit requires Q1=PASS and Q2=PASS on the same candidate/scope after durable terminal readback. Any disagreement means no promotion and no credit.

fixed_trace.expected: do not promote E; do not award credit; enter CHECKER_DISAGREEMENT

fixed_trace.event: duplicate/paraphrase Q1 presented as second checker
fixed_trace.expected: reject as non-independent; still no promotion
UNKNOWN, not PASS; still no promotion
after both terminal artifacts are sealed/read back, promote F at fresh authority epoch

fixed_trace.event: late completion from prior authority/checker generation
fixed_trace.expected: reject stale completion; authority remains F

fixed_trace.control: all bounded candidates have Q1/Q2 disagreement
fixed_trace.expected: remain unresolved with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

guards.G1: one checker alone can never grant authority or credit
guards.G2: Q2 must use a materially different rule/evidence view from Q1; copies do not count as diversity
guards.G3: E with Q1 PASS / Q2 FAIL is rejected
guards.G4: checker disagreement is quarantined, not averaged into a synthetic PASS
guards.G5: transport/tool failure for either checker is UNKNOWN, never PASS
guards.G6: F is promotable only when both same-scope terminal checks PASS
guards.G7: promotion occurs only after durable seal/readback of both required checker artifacts
guards.G8: scope mismatch, duplicates, and nonterminal evidence cannot satisfy a checker gate
guards.G9: authority/checker generation advances on successful promotion and rejects old-generation completions
guards.G10: bounded all-disagree control remains unresolved with nonempty frontier and zero credit
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 all hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit. At most one credit after terminal artifact readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting assignment-switch/recovery failure mode, preferably one concerning checker correlation or evidence diversity that remains after this fixed two-view trace.
